about: Tracking plan: every analytics event, its props and history. The source for ANALYTICS.md, the old-name translation in functions/ingest/batch.js and the PostHog event descriptions. Edit here, then run node tools/events.js --write. Types: int, number, bool, enum (has values), catalog_id (a catalog id or custom), catalog_ids (a list of them), code (a name from the app's code, never typed by the user), text (may hold text from outside the app's code; needs why). since / removed: app version. was: old names, translated by the ingest function.

areas.today: Today page: progress, and its cards that aren't care
areas.care: Care actions: tasks on «Сегодня» and logs in the plant card
areas.plant: Plant card and the plants list

distinct_id.desc: random UUID in `localStorage['zhungli.anon']`, one per device; its first 8 characters are shown in settings so a user can ask to delete their data

$geoip_country_code.desc: country from Cloudflare, added by the proxy

plants_total.desc: number of plants on the device

standalone.desc: `true` when opened from the home screen

in_telegram.desc: `true` when opened inside Telegram's own browser (detectable on Android, often not on iOS)

mini_app.desc: `true` when opened as the Telegram mini app (`/tg`, @JunglyApp)

tg_version.desc: mini app: Telegram's Bot API version

tg_platform.desc: mini app: Telegram's client (ios, macos, tdesktop…)

app_opened.when: app starts, or returns after 30+ min in background

tasks_due.desc: tasks waiting on Today at that moment (watering checks shown and greenhouse vents, not «Если есть силы»)

values.privacy_return: reloaded on the way back from the privacy page, within 30 min; not a new launch
values.retry: reloaded itself after a script or the stylesheet failed, see `app_health_start_retried`; not a new launch

ready_ms.desc: ms from navigation start until the first screen is built; not for `resume`, nor when started in background

$referring_domain.desc: `start` only, once per arrival (a reload with the same referrer sends none): where the app was opened from, as a known source from `REF_SOURCES` in `app.js` (`google.com`, `t.me`, `vk.com`…; Android apps by package), `other` for any other site, or `$direct` (no referrer, or the app itself)

app_privacy_opened.when: link to the privacy page tapped

app_author_link_clicked.when: author link in settings, «Что нового» or a failed AI import

care_watering_task_finished.when: «Полито» or «Ещё влажно» on a watering card on «Сегодня» (the words depend on how the plant grows: «Долито» / «Вода есть», «Вода сменена», drip irrigation «Работает» / «Поправлено»)

care_watering_logged.when: «Полито сегодня» in the plant card's «Полив» (words depend on how the plant grows, like the card's); since v175 the card stays open

plant_checked.when: answer on a check card, or «Полито сегодня» in the plant card; split into `watering_task_finished` (`dry` / `wet`), `watering_task_snoozed` (`later`) and `watering_logged` (`from: card`)

care_watering_task_tip_opened.when: «Как?» opened on a watering card (the watering tip; open by itself for a plant's first 3 checks)

care_watering_undone.when: «×» on the newest answer in the plant card's «История», confirmed

answer.desc: the answer taken back, in `care_watering_task_finished` words; a «Полито сегодня» is `dry`; drip irrigation: `dry` is «Работает», `wet` «Поправлено»

restored.desc: the entry had the state before it (since v152), so the interval and next check went back

today_finished.when: last check of the day done

care_greenhouse_task_shown.when: vent cards («Проветрите теплицу») drawn on «Сегодня», once per launch and day, while the app is on screen
care_greenhouse_task_shown.note: The funnel's first step: count devices.

care_quarantine_task_shown.when: pest checks («Осмотрите на вредителей») drawn on «Сегодня», once per launch and day, while the app is on screen
care_quarantine_task_shown.note: The funnel's first step: count devices.

count.desc: pest checks shown (one per new plant)

care_quarantine_task_finished.when: «Осмотрено» on a new plant's pest check («Уже не новое» is `plant_setting_quarantine_toggled` `from: task`)

bonus_shown.when: «Если есть силы» bonus tasks drawn on «Сегодня», once per launch and day, while the app is on screen; the feeding day, pruning and the bath day have their own
bonus_shown.note: The funnel's first step: count devices. Split by kind in v172: the care kinds are `care_bonus_task_shown`, `backup` and `feedback` are `today_bonus_task_shown`. Not translated at ingest.

count.desc: bonus tasks shown (dust, turning, medium care, backup, feedback)

bonus_finished.note: Split by kind in v172: the care kinds are `care_bonus_task_*`, `backup` and `feedback` are `today_bonus_task_*`. Not translated at ingest (nor its older name `bonus_done`).
bonus_finished.when: bonus task done (the feeding day is `feed_day_finished`, the bath day `bath_day_finished`, pruning `prune_task_finished` since v163)

values.prune: a reminder turned on in the plant card, up to v162

bonus_skipped.note: Split by kind in v172: the care kinds are `care_bonus_task_*`, `backup` and `feedback` are `today_bonus_task_*`. Not translated at ingest.
bonus_skipped.when: bonus task snoozed («Через 3 дня»), or «Не нужно» on «Как вам Жунгли?» (the bath day is `bath_day_snoozed` since v160, the feeding day `feed_day_snoozed` since v162, pruning `prune_task_snoozed` since v163)

values.bath: the bath day, up to v159
values.feed: the feeding day, up to v161

care_watering_task_shown.when: watering cards drawn on «Сегодня», once per launch and day, while the app is on screen
care_watering_task_shown.note: The funnel's first step: count devices.

waiting.desc: more checks due but over the daily limit («Ещё N растений подождут до завтра»)

care_bonus_task_shown.when: «Если есть силы» care bonus tasks (dust, turning, medium care) drawn on «Сегодня», once per launch and day, while the app is on screen; the feeding day, pruning and the bath day have their own. Before v172: `bonus_shown`, which also counted the backup and feedback tasks.
care_bonus_task_shown.note: The funnel's first step: count devices.

care_bonus_task_finished.when: a care bonus task done. Before v172: `bonus_finished` with these kinds.

care_bonus_task_snoozed.when: «Через 3 дня» on a care bonus task. Before v172: `bonus_skipped` with these kinds.

today_shown.when: «Сегодня» drawn with plants, once per launch and day, while the app is on screen
today_shown.note: A day with `total: 0` is a day off («Сегодня отдыхаем»).

total.desc: today's tasks: checks, vents and pest checks, done or not (the «X из Y» bar)

waiting.desc: checks due but over the daily limit

bonus.desc: «Если есть силы» cards, the bath day included

today_left.when: the app goes to background on a day with tasks, after «Сегодня» was drawn in this launch; only when the progress changed since the last report
today_left.note: The day's last `today_left` shows how far people got.

today_bonus_task_shown.when: a bonus task that isn't care drawn on «Сегодня», once per launch and day for each, while the app is on screen. Before v172: part of `bonus_shown`.

today_bonus_task_finished.when: «Написать» on «Как вам Жунгли?» (the backup task is done by saving the file: `app_data_exported` `from: task`). Before v172: `bonus_finished` `kind: feedback`.

today_bonus_task_snoozed.when: «Через 3 дня» on the backup task. Before v172: `bonus_skipped` `kind: backup`.

today_bonus_task_dismissed.when: «Не нужно» on «Как вам Жунгли?» (it doesn't ask again). Before v172: `bonus_skipped` `kind: feedback`.

care_feed_day_shown.when: the «День подкормки» card drawn on «Сегодня», once per launch and day, while the app is on screen
care_feed_day_shown.note: The funnel's first step: count devices.

count.desc: plants on the card (due by their own schedule)

of.desc: plants on the card; the unticked ones come back in 3 days

care_feed_day_snoozed.when: «Через 3 дня» on the «День подкормки» card (before v162: `bonus_skipped` `kind: feed`)

care_bath_day_shown.when: the bath day card's step 1 («Устраиваем сегодня банный день?») drawn on «Сегодня», once per launch and day
care_bath_day_shown.note: The funnel's first step: count devices.

care_bath_day_started.when: step 1 of the bath day card: «Да!» on «Устраиваем сегодня банный день?»

care_bath_day_snoozed.when: step 1 of the bath day card: «Через 3 дня» (before v160: `bonus_skipped` `kind: bath`)

care_bath_day_picked.when: step 2 of the bath day card: «Пошли купать!» after ticking who gets bathed
care_bath_day_picked.note: Sent again after «Назад» and a new pick, so count devices or take a device's last pick.

of.desc: plants offered (at most `BATH_MAX`, dry pots only)

care_bath_day_finished.when: step 3 of the bath day card: «Промыто»

care_prune_task_shown.when: «Обрежьте: …» tasks drawn on «Сегодня», once per launch and day, while the app is on screen
care_prune_task_shown.note: The funnel's first step: count devices.

care_prune_task_snoozed.when: «Через 3 дня» on a «Обрежьте: …» task (before v163: `bonus_skipped` `kind: prune`)

today_winter_hint_hidden.when: «Понятно» on the winter light hint on «Сегодня»

plant_opened.when: plant card opened by a tap

tab.desc: the tab it opened on (since v166)

from.desc: the app's tab it was opened from (since v174); in practice `today` or `plants`: rows on Light and Room don't open cards

plant_tab_opened.when: another tab of the plant card opened by a tap or the arrow keys (the tab it opens on is `tab` in `plant_opened`)

plant_tag_opened.when: a tag under the plant's words in the plant card tapped and its bubble opened (closing it sends nothing)

tag.desc: the tag's kind; the same values as `plants_filtered` `status` where both have it

position.desc: the tag's place in the row, from 1

count.desc: how many tags the row has

plant_setting_opened.when: a row of the plant card's «Настройки» opened

values.water: «Полив», since v181 (before: always open, not a row)
values.way: «В чём растёт»; before v181 «Как растёт», with «Как поливаю» (now inside «Полив», not a row)

plant_setting_name_changed.when: nickname set or changed (clearing it sends nothing)

plant_photo_removed.when: photo removed from a plant (back to the drawing)

plant_note_changed.when: cheat sheet note changed in the plant card

plant_setting_lux_changed.when: lux reading saved (clearing it sends nothing)

plant_setting_room_changed.when: another «Комната» chip picked in the plant card (with 2+ rooms; no room name sent)

plant_setting_spot_changed.when: another spot picked in the plant card: a spot chip, or a spot typed in the new spot field that is already in the list (no spot name sent); a new spot typed there is `app_setting_spot_changed` `action: added, from: card`

plant_setting_grow_changed.when: «В чём растёт» or «Как поливаю» changed in the plant card

plant_setting_watering_schedule_changed.when: how often the watering check comes, changed in the plant card's «Проверка» (inside «Как растёт» before v175): a chip for drip irrigation (it doesn't learn), or − / + for the others
plant_setting_watering_schedule_changed.note: A run of − / + taps sends one event, 1.2 s after the last tap (at once when the app hides), and none if it ends where it began.

values.stepper: − / + under «Проверять примерно каждые» (since v175 its own row, «Проверка»)

plant_setting_card_changed.when: a plant moved to another catalog card («Сменить карточку» in the plant card)

same_medium.desc: the plant's medium is the new card's

searched.desc: something was typed in the search; searches there send no `add_catalog_searched`

plant_setting_greenhouse_toggled.when: «Стоит в теплице или под колпаком?» in the plant card, or «Без теплицы» on the vent card

from.desc: since v164 (before: card only; the vent card sent `greenhouse_removed`)

values.task: «Без теплицы» on the vent card, confirmed

plant_setting_quarantine_toggled.when: «Новое» in the plant card (before v181 «Недавно купили»), or «Уже не новое» on the task

plant_setting_repot_toggled.when: «Пересажено» in the plant card (before v181 «Недавно пересажено»)

plant_setting_rest_started.when: «Да» on «Сейчас в покое?» in the plant card (before v175: the «Сбросила листья» / «Ушла в зимний покой» button)

plant_setting_rest_ended.when: «Нет» on «Сейчас в покое?» in the plant card (since v175), or the button in the rest box above the tabs («Появился новый лист» / «Пошли новые ловушки»)

plant_setting_feed_lamp_toggled.when: «Зимой стоит под лампой?» in the plant card (its own row «Лампа» under «Свет» since v181, inside «Подкормка» before)

care_feed_logged.when: «Подкормлено сегодня» in the plant card's «Подкормка» (before v162: `feeding_logged` `from: card`)

plant_setting_prune_toggled.when: «Звать на обрезку?» in the plant card's «Обрезка»

on.desc: `true`: switched on, with the card's start interval and months

plant_setting_prune_schedule_changed.when: how often chip under «Звать на обрезку?» in the plant card

plant_setting_prune_months_changed.when: a month chip under «Звать на обрезку?» in the plant card

months.desc: how many months are on now

care_bath_logged.when: «Промыто сегодня» in the plant card's «Промывка грунта»

plant_setting_bath_toggled.when: «Звать в банный день?» in the plant card

on.desc: `true` for «Да»: the plant joins the bath day

plants_filter_opened.when: the «Фильтр» field under the Plants search tapped: the «Фильтр» sheet opens

status.desc: what the list shows when the sheet opens

plants_filtered.when: a chip tapped under the Plants search; since v177, a chip in the «Фильтр» sheet or × on the «Фильтр» field

plants_searched.when: search on the Plants tab typed (1.2 s pause, no search text sent)

from.desc: the tab it was opened on, or (since v171) `empty`: «Другие растения» on an empty page, `help`: «Искать в каталоге» in name help

add_finished.when: plants added from the picker, the custom form or AI import

values.quick: the quick tiles, on an empty page or in the last story (`from`)
values.stories: before v171: tiles in the last story; now `quick` with `from: stories`

from.desc: quick: where the tiles were; since v171

generic_count.desc: how many are generic catalog cards

catalog_ids.desc: catalog, quick and stories picks; import: plants matched to catalog cards

parts.desc: import: pastes and files that added plants (an answer in several messages or continued)

cut.desc: import: the last part broke off mid-list

repaired.desc: import: the answer needed fixing (quotes, spaced numbers, comments)

unread.desc: import: plants written so badly they were skipped, summed over the parts that added plants

file_ext.desc: import, when a file was used

own_count.desc: import: not in the catalog (own plants like a generic type)

already.desc: import: rows already in the collection, so unticked at first; `found` minus `count` is what was left out

guess_count.desc: import: the AI said the species is a guess from a photo

with_room.desc: import: how many came with a room (no names sent)

with_spot.desc: import: how many came with a place (no names sent)

catalog_id.desc: custom: the generic type it was based on

tuned.desc: custom: light, interval, type or tip changed by hand in «Тонкая настройка»

values.search_miss: «Добавить как своё» after a catalog search found nothing

add_custom_field_changed.when: a field of the own plant form changed (text fields on leaving them)

add_custom_tune_opened.when: «Тонкая настройка» opened in the own plant form

add_quick_shown.when: the quick tiles («Что у вас растёт?») drawn by themselves: on an empty page once per launch and day for each tab (not while the stories cover it: then once they close), in the stories once per opening. The funnel's first step: count devices.

add_quick_ticked.when: a quick tile ticked or unticked

quick_abandoned.when: tiles on an empty screen were ticked but not added; replaced by `add_abandoned` `part: quick`

add_catalog_searched.when: catalog search typed (1.2 s pause, no search text sent)

typo.desc: `true` when only the typo-forgiving pass found something

add_catalog_missed.when: the add sheet closed after a search that found nothing: once, with the last such search (a fixed typo or a later hit clears it)
add_catalog_missed.note: To learn which plants the catalog lacks.

query.desc: what was typed, up to 40 characters
query.why: to learn which plants the catalog lacks; told to users in privacy.html

added.desc: whether plants were added in the end

add_abandoned.when: a way of adding left without adding: the add sheet closed, or quick tiles ticked but not added (once, when the person turns to another way of adding, leaves the app or closes the stories)

part.desc: the part left: the add sheet's last one shown, or the quick tiles

then.desc: quick: what they turned to instead of «Добавить»; they may still add there

step.desc: import: the step it was left on

left_app.desc: the app went to background with the sheet open; not reported when the import prompt was copied or the file picker is open, since going to the AI chat or to Files is expected

values.empty: «Перенести из чата с ИИ» on an empty page

restored.desc: it opened where an unfinished import stopped (kept on the device for 3 hours)

add_import_step_shown.when: AI import moved to another step by a tap («Отправлено, дальше», a format, «Проверить список», «Назад», «Вставить ещё часть», «Вставить продолжение»)
add_import_step_shown.note: Sent on every move, unlike the care `*_shown` events (once a day). An import reopened where it stopped sends `add_import_opened` with `step` instead.

add_import_prompt_copied.when: «Скопировать запрос» in AI import, or «Скопировать ещё раз» under the shown prompt

values.clipboard: only the Clipboard API worked; it can still fail silently on iPhone
values.failed: both refused, or copying hung for 5 s: the prompt is shown to copy by hand

values.again: the button under the shown prompt

add_import_prompt_opened.when: «Не вставляется? Показать запрос» in AI import: copying didn't reach the AI chat

add_import_answer_read.when: a pasted answer or a picked file had plants (import step 3)

repeated.desc: already read from an earlier part

matched.desc: new ones with a catalog card

add_import_answer_failed.when: a pasted answer or a picked file has no plant list
add_import_answer_failed.note: No text or file content is sent.

values.backup: a Жунгли backup, not an AI answer
values.bad_json: could not be read even after repairs
values.no_plants: read, but no plant had a name

unread.desc: with `bad_json`: how many `{…}` couldn't be read

import_clipboard.when: only in preview builds of AI import (v154–155), never on main

stories_opened.when: «Как работают Жунгли» opened: by itself on the first launch, from the install card or hint, or from settings

values.settings: «Как работают Жунгли» at the top of settings
values.home_icon: first launch of the iPhone home-screen app: opens on the last story
values.install_card: no plants yet, straight to the last story
values.install_hint: iPhone, plants already added, straight to the last story
values.return: back in the app to stories still open: not a way in, see `left` in `stories_closed`
values.today: «Показать, как» on «Сегодня», in early versions, seen up to v115

stories_closed.note: Leaving the app may be the last event, so it's sent then (after the Telegram button as `telegram`); coming back sends `stories_opened` `return`, so each open has one close and a device can have several: count its last one. Tiles ticked in the last story but not added are `add_abandoned` `part: quick, from: stories` (before v171: `ticked` here).

from.desc: as in `stories_opened` for this run of them (`return` never: the first open's)

seen.desc: how many stories were shown (opened on the last one: 1, unless they went back)

values.add: plants added from the last story's tiles
values.restore: before v151: links under the last story's tiles
values.restored: the mini app got plants from Telegram's cloud while they were open
values.followed: left the app from a last story with steps out of here: to Safari, or to the home screen after «На экран Домой»
values.left: left the app with them open anywhere else
values.open_browser: early versions: the last story's link to open the app in the browser

ending.desc: if the last story was seen

paused.desc: times the animation was paused (press and hold, or Space); since v173

stories_story_shown.when: a story shown: the first one when they open, then each move on or back
stories_story_shown.note: The time to the next one is how long a story was watched (coming back to the app after leaving sends no new one). Going back: `story` < `from_story`.

story.desc: the story shown (1–6; 6 is the last, with the plant tiles or the install steps)

from_story.desc: the story before it; 0 when they open

values.tap: a tap on the story: the left third goes back, the rest goes on
values.button: «Дальше» / «Назад», the buttons shown with keyboard focus

app_install_card_shown.when: no plants yet, and the plant picker is replaced by the way to install (once per launch)
app_install_card_shown.note: On iPhone the home-screen app gets a new device id, so compare installs with this event as a ratio, not per device.

app_install_card_declined.when: «Остаться в браузере» / «Остаться здесь» on that card: the plant picker shows

app_install_hint_hidden.when: an install hint closed: the home screen hint, the mini app's, or the one in Telegram's browser

values.ios_added: iPhone, no plants yet: «Уже добавили» on the install-first card; the browser then points to the icon
values.ios_move: iPhone, move with a backup: «Уже на экране»
values.ios_icon_move: same after «Уже добавили»: «Не нужно» on «Перенесите растения в иконку»
values.telegram_browser: Telegram's browser, «Понятно» on «Удобнее в приложении Телеграма»; since v169, before that `telegram_hint_hidden`
values.in_app: another app's browser on iPhone or Android

app_install_prompt_answered.when: Android or computer: «Установить» on the install hint, after the browser's dialog

app_installed.when: the browser reports Жунгли was installed (from the hint or the browser's own menu)

app_install_hint_clicked.when: mini app: «Добавить» on the home screen hint (Telegram's own dialog); «Не нужно» there is `app_install_hint_hidden` `where: telegram`

app_data_cloud_checked.when: mini app: first cloud check after launch

app_data_cloud_failed.when: mini app: Telegram CloudStorage refused a read or write (once per kind per launch)

error.desc: Telegram's error text, up to 80 characters
error.why: to fix sync; it comes from Telegram, never from the user

app_data_photos_synced.when: mini app: photos synced through Telegram's cloud (only when something happened)

removed.desc: of removed plants or removed photos

app_data_cloud_restored.when: mini app: plants restored from Telegram CloudStorage on this phone

tasks_due.desc: as in `app_opened`: the launch event went out before the restore

app_install_mini_app_clicked.when: «Открыть» in Telegram's browser (opens the mini app): on the install card or the hint

values.card: the install card, no plants yet
values.hint: the hint «Удобнее в приложении Телеграма» / «Растения здесь могут потеряться»

telegram_hint_hidden.when: «Понятно» on the Telegram hint; replaced by `app_install_hint_hidden` `where: telegram_browser`

app_setting_pets_toggled.when: «Дома есть кошка или собака» in settings

app_setting_bath_day_toggled.when: «Банный день» checkbox in the app's settings

on.desc: `true`: switched on, which sets every 120 days

app_setting_bath_day_schedule_changed.when: «Как часто купать каждое растение» chip under «Банный день» in the app's settings

values.install_hint: the iPhone «add to home screen» hint, to move plants into the home-screen app
values.in_app_hint: another app's browser, to move plants to Safari or the browser

app_data_reset.when: «Начать с чистого листа» confirmed in settings

room_climate_changed.when: a room's temperature and humidity saved («Записать» on the Room tab)

light_shown.when: the Light tab drawn with plants, once per launch and day, while the app is on screen

measured.desc: plants with a lux reading («замерено N из M»)

room_shown.when: the Room tab drawn with plants, once per launch and day, while the app is on screen

rooms.desc: all rooms, with plants or not

with_reading.desc: rooms with a temperature and humidity reading

days_since_reading.desc: days since the newest reading (0: today); not sent without one

app_setting_room_changed.when: the list of rooms changed: a room added, renamed or removed (its plants move to another room); no room name sent

values.settings: the rooms in the app's settings

app_setting_spot_changed.when: the list of spots changed: a spot added in the app's settings, or a new one typed in the plant card's new spot field (it then becomes the plant's spot; empty field: nothing), or removed in the app's settings (confirmed if plants stood there)

values.settings: the spots in the app's settings

plants.desc: removed: plants left without a spot

room_added.when: a room added (no room name sent); replaced by `app_setting_room_changed` `action: added`

room_removed.when: a room removed (no room name sent); replaced by `app_setting_room_changed` `action: removed`

plant_setting_spot_added.when: a spot typed in the plant card's new spot field and added; replaced by `app_setting_spot_changed` `action: added, from: card`

new_spot.desc: not in the spot list before

spot_added.when: a spot typed in the plant card's new spot field and added; renamed `plant_setting_spot_added` in v166, now `app_setting_spot_changed` `action: added, from: card`

new_spot.desc: not in the spot list before

app_health_script_failed.when: script error, at most 5 per page load

message.why: to fix errors; the browser's error message, from the app's code

source.desc: file (one file per part of the app since v89; before that, mostly `app.js`)

app_health_start_retried.when: the page reloaded itself once because a script or the stylesheet failed to load, or a script didn't fit the others (usually a flaky network on the first launch of a new version); sent after the reload

started.desc: the first screen was built anyway, but some buttons would do nothing or it had no styles

$web_vitals.when: app goes to background or closes, with the values that changed since the last report
$web_vitals.note: INP leaves out the time a native `prompt`/`confirm` was open, so it can be lower than in CrUX. From the browser's own timings: FCP everywhere; LCP, INP and CLS where supported.

visit.desc: random id; a visit starts at launch or with `app_opened` `resume`, and INP starts over with it; a visit can report several times, so take its last values

app_health_tap_slowed.when: a tap or key press took 200+ ms until the next frame, at most 10 per visit. The time a native `prompt`/`confirm` was open is taken out (it's the user's)

target.desc: the control's `data-act`, `tab-<tab>`, `open-plant` or static element id

event.desc: the one whose handlers ran longest: `pointerup`, `click`, `keydown`…

app_health_viewport_stuck.when: iPhone home-screen app or Telegram mini app: after the keyboard, the screen height stayed short and the app made iOS re-measure it; at most 3 per launch

full.desc: tallest height seen at this width

app_data_change_dropped.when: a change in a stale window wasn't saved: another window (browser or installed app, which share storage on Android and computers) had saved newer data, so this one took it instead

ui_clicked.when: any tap on a button, link or other control (fields are `field_changed`); also arrow keys on the plant card's tabs (`card-<tab>`)

target.desc: the control's `data-act`, `tab-<tab>`, `open-plant` or static element id (as in `app_health_tap_slowed`); links: `link-<data-out or href>`

field_changed.when: any input, select or textarea changed (text fields on leaving them)

greenhouse_removed.when: greenhouse removed from the vent card; replaced by `plant_setting_greenhouse_toggled` `on: false, from: task`

reminder_changed.when: «Звать на обрезку?» or its options changed in the plant card; replaced by `plant_setting_prune_toggled`, `plant_setting_prune_schedule_changed` and `plant_setting_prune_months_changed`. `kind: rinse` is the per-plant rinse reminder that became «Банный день»

months.desc: how many months are on, unless off

feeding_logged.when: plants noted as fed; replaced by `feed_day_finished` (`from: day`) and `feed_logged` (`from: card`)

bath_day_changed.when: «Банный день» in the app's settings turned on, off, or its interval changed; replaced by `app_setting_bath_day_toggled` and `app_setting_bath_day_schedule_changed` (`every: 120` was either)

answer_undone.when: «×» on the newest answer in the plant card's «История», confirmed; replaced by `watering_undone` (other answer words). Up to v158 its plant props were `plant_kind` and `plant_type`

bath_opt_out.when: «Звать в банный день?» in the plant card; replaced by `plant_setting_bath_toggled` (`on` the other way round)

wick_toggled.when: «Фитильный полив» ticked or unticked in the plant card; replaced by `plant_setting_grow_changed`
